convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'T3MA-ALARM' custom indicator for signal generation. The custom indicator applies double-smoothed MA logic not available as a built-in MT5 indicator, requiring replication of the indicator's calculation in Python.

indicators.name: MA Handle 2 (second smoothing applied to MA Handle 1)

derived_values.name: BufDir - direction state derived from comparing double-smoothed MA values
derived_values.formula: BufDir[i] = 1 if BufMA[i-MAShift] > BufMA[i-MAShift-1], -1 if BufMA[i-MAShift] < BufMA[i-MAShift-1], else BufDir[i-1]

derived_values.name: BufBuy - buy arrow buffer (non-zero = buy signal)
BufSell - sell arrow buffer (non-zero = sell signal)

other_exits: Position close uses spread*3 as deviation/slippage tolerance for Trade.PositionClose

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads indicator buffers 1 (Buy arrow) and 2 (Sell arrow) from the T3MA-ALARM custom indicator. A non-zero value in buffer 1 signals a buy, non-zero in buffer 2 signals a sell. The indicator internally computes a double-smoothed MA (EMA applied twice to the same period) and detects direction changes: when the double-smoothed MA turns up from a declining state, a buy signal is generated; when it turns down from a rising state, a sell signal is generated. The Shift parameter (default 1) controls which bar's signals are evaluated, with Shift=1 meaning the last confirmed bar. RevClose=true means opposite signals close existing positions before new entries are considered. Position close deviation is set to Sym.Spread()*3.
python_conversion_notes: The custom T3MA-ALARM indicator must be reimplemented in Python: apply EMA twice to the close price series (same period), then detect direction changes by comparing current vs previous double-smoothed MA values. Buy signal = double-smoothed MA crosses above (was falling, now rising). Sell signal = double-smoothed MA crosses below (was rising, now falling). The Shift parameter defaults to 1, meaning signals are checked on the previously closed bar, not the forming bar. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is needed. StopLoss defaults to 0 (disabled). TakeProfit defaults to 300 points. The position gate checks if no position exists before opening. RevClose flag enables closing on opposite signal. The standard Trade/SymbolInfo/PositionInfo MQH libraries are only used for order execution and symbol info - replace with broker API equivalents in Python.
